instruction: Press down on the blue stapler with smooth finish with the left arm

source.instruction: Press down on the blue stapler with smooth finish with the left arm

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the stapler, which was at x = -19 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm horizontally toward (-20.5, -5.5, 94), orient pointing down and align yaw with stapler.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +13, -0) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the stapler

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-21, -6, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper to z=88 and close gripper fingers to form a pressing contact point.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, -0, -6) cm, now 3 cm (horizontal) / +14 cm (vertical) from the stapler; closed the gripper (opening 0.00: nothing held)

frames.plan: Maintain closed gripper state and stabilize position before pressing down.

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-20, -6, 88) opening 0.00; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm slightly forward and down to z=83 to press down on the stapler.
